$comment: Every module, type, port and public function of the rebuilt code with its Swift, C# and C spelling (rearchitecture plan §5.4). tools/check-architecture.py checks that each entry exists at its path on all three platforms, that the spellings follow the naming rules (--lint), and lists public symbols the map doesn't have. Phase 0 covers Foundation, Domain and Ports; later phases add Adapters, Engine, Server, Client, hosts and ViewModels. 'phase' is when an entry must exist (check-architecture.py --require-phase N fails on missing entries of phase ≤ N).

rules: Type: the same name in Swift and C#; Bro + name in C. A port is `protocol X` (Swift), `interface IX` (C#), `BroX` GObject interface (C).
Function Owner.f(a, b): Swift `Owner.f(_:b:)` (the first parameter unlabelled unless written 'label:name', the others labelled by their name or label); C# `Owner.F`; C `bro_<owner>_<f>`, snake case.
Files: one per type, named after it: Swift `<Root>/<Folder>/<Type>.swift`, C# `<Root>/<Folder>/<Type>.cs` (`I<Port>.cs` for ports), C `<Root>/<folder>/bro-<type>.h` and `.c`, kebab case.
Enum case c of E: Swift `.c`, C# `C`, C `BRO_<E>_<C>`, upper snake case.
Message codes: Swift MessageCode.ripReadErrors, C# MessageCode.RipReadErrors, C BRO_MSG_RIP_READ_ERRORS; the wire form is rip.readErrors (codes.json).

ui.note: macos/Bromelia and windows/src/Bromelia.App hold today's apps until phase 4 replaces them.

cs.why: Plan §6: the exception that carries a BroError across layers (Swift uses typed throws, C a BroError ** out-parameter).
C# enums have no raw values: EnumWire gives a case's camelCase wire form and parses it (Swift: String raw values; C: bro_<enum>_to_wire / _from_wire).

c.why: Plan §6: C has no enums with values, so JsonValue's cases get constructors and accessors (bro_json_value_new_string, bro_json_value_member, …); Swift and C# use cases and records.
Plan §6: sets a BroError ** out-parameter when it isn't NULL, like g_set_error; Swift and C# throw.
A property in Swift and C# (isCancelled / IsCancelled).
Removes an onCancel handler; Swift and C# return a closure / IDisposable for that.
Builds the header list; Swift and C# pass the headers to the initialiser.
An enum case's wire form (Swift: raw value; C#: EnumWire.Name).
An enum case from its wire form (Swift: init(rawValue:); C#: EnumWire.Parse).
A ProcessExit with only an exit status (Swift and C# use default arguments).
